decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions and due to the appropriate scale, design and location of the extension, the proposal would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the house or local area.  The proposal is consistent with the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to house
